title: Updating Points Immediately and Explaining The 30-Second / 20-Second Shot Timer
trigger_condition: A team scores (+1, +2, or +3 points), grabs their own missed shot ('offensive rebound'), or lets the shot timer run down near zero.
editor_action: Add the points to the scoreboard the instant the ball drops through the net. In college basketball, a team gets 30 seconds to attempt a shot, or 20 seconds if they grab their own missed shot near the hoop; flash a clear '20s Reset' note on an offensive rebound and turn the timer bright red in the final seconds.
timing_constraint: Sub-second scoreboard update after a made basket and brief on-screen note explaining shot-timer resets (example: 0.4s score update, 4.5s explanation pill).
plain_english_tip: Offensive Rebound: Catching your own team's missed shot resets the NCAA shot clock to 20 seconds for an extra scoring chance.

title: Near-Sideline Ball Occlusion Check (Never Cover The Ball-Handler with a Graphic)
trigger_condition: A lower-third banner is on screen or about to air while a player is dribbling or inbounding the ball along the bottom sideline of CAM-1 (the part of the court closest to the bottom of the TV screen).
editor_action: Track where the ball and ball-handler are on the screen. If the player dribbles into the bottom 25% of the video frame where the lower-third banner sits, immediately hide or delay the banner so the graphic never covers up the live basketball.
timing_constraint: Dismiss or hold lower-third banners within 0.2s whenever the ball bounding box enters the bottom 25% overlay zone.

title: Full-Screen Starting Lineup Graphic Exit Before Center-Circle Toss
trigger_condition: Pre-game starting 5 graphics and defensive matchup diagrams are displayed while players walk onto the floor for the opening tip-off. (Visual cue: Full-screen 5-player headshot cards for both teams; Audio cue: Announcers introducing the starting lineups and keys to the game.)
editor_action: Clear all full-screen starting lineup graphics at least 3 seconds before the referee steps between the two centers at midcourt, ensuring the entire screen is unobstructed for the opening jump ball (example: clear full-screen overlays >= 3.0s before tip-off). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: clear full-screen overlays >= 3.0s before tip-off. Never leave a full-screen graphic up while the ball is tossed in the air.
plain_english_tip: 10-Second Backcourt: The offense has 10 seconds to dribble across the center line and cannot pass back behind it once across.

title: Telestrator Drawing Auto-Clear on Camera Switch
trigger_condition: An analyst draws yellow telestrator lines on a replay clip, and the director suddenly cuts back to CAM-1 (Main Wide) for live action. (Visual cue: Telestrator ink lines drawn over a specific camera angle; Audio cue: Live play resuming.)
editor_action: Tie the telestrator overlay layer directly to the active replay camera ID so that the exact millisecond the video switcher cuts to a different camera, all drawn ink lines vanish automatically (example: 0-frame persistence of telestrator ink across camera cuts). Recommended framing: Replay Feed -> Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Never allow telestrator arrows drawn on a replay to float meaninglessly over the live court view (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)

title: Maximum Two Concurrent Graphic Layers Rule
trigger_condition: Multiple data triggers fire at once (e.g., persistent scorebug + player stat card + sponsor logo + shot chart). (Visual cue: Multiple graphic templates requesting screen space simultaneously; Audio cue: Busy statistical commentary segment.)
editor_action: Enforce a hard ceiling of at most two concurrent graphic layers on screen at any time (the persistent scorebug plus at most one contextual card or drawer), queuing any additional graphics for subsequent possessions (example: max 2 active graphic layers; total screen occlusion <= 18% during live play). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: max 2 active graphic layers; total screen occlusion <= 18% during live play. Never stack a player lower-third, a side panel, and a pop-up badge on screen at the same time.

title: Corrupted / Missing Stat Feed Value Suppression
trigger_condition: The live statistical data API sends a null, negative, or implausible value (e.g., 0/0 FG for a player who just scored 15 points, or NaN%) to a graphic template. (Visual cue: Graphic template preparing to render on screen; Audio cue: Normal game commentary.)
editor_action: Validate every statistical field before rendering a graphic overlay; if any field contains a missing, NaN, or contradictory value, suppress that graphic card entirely rather than airing broken text on television (example: pre-render schema check blocks malformed stat cards). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Fall back to a simple verified player name and jersey number badge if detailed stats are unavailable (Trigger safe-harbor fallback to CAM-1 Wide within < 0.5s of confidence drop.)

title: Physical Arena Stanchion LED Clock vs. Broadcast Scorebug Alignment
trigger_condition: On a tight baseline or backboard shot, the physical arena shot clock mounted above the backboard is visible inside the video frame. (Visual cue: Physical red/amber LED numbers above the hoop visible alongside the digital broadcast scorebug; Audio cue: Clock winding down.)
editor_action: Synchronize the digital broadcast scorebug clock to the arena's official timing feed within a tenth of a second so the viewer never sees conflicting numbers between the physical arena clock and the on-screen scorebug (example: <= 0.1s sync tolerance via arena data feed). Recommended framing: Baseline Close-Up (CAM-2, Baseline Low).
timing_constraint: Target window: <= 0.1s sync tolerance via arena data feed. During official clock-adjustment reviews, trust the physical backboard LED clock for frame-by-frame replay verification.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Replay Status Badge ('Replay' / '2X Slow') Corner Pinning
trigger_condition: Any recorded replay clip is playing on screen instead of live court action. (Visual cue: Slow-motion or recorded angle of a recent play; Audio cue: Analyst narrating the replay.)
editor_action: Pin a clear 'REPLAY' indicator badge in a consistent corner of the screen whenever recorded footage is airing so a viewer who just glanced up at the television never mistakes a replay basket for a second live basket (example: persistent 'REPLAY' pill during all non-live clips). Recommended framing: Replay Feed (CAM-2 (Baseline Low), CAM-3 (Player Close-Up), or CAM-5 (Above-Rim)).
timing_constraint: Remove the 'REPLAY' badge the exact frame live court action returns (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)

title: Simultaneous Scoring & Away-From-The-Ball Foul Disambiguation
trigger_condition: A player shoots a three-pointer while a whistle blows for an off-ball foul inside the paint at the exact same moment. (Visual cue: Ball goes through the hoop, but the referee waves off the basket or points to a foul on the floor before the shot; Audio cue: Crowd cheers for the three-pointer, then groans as the referee waves it off.)
editor_action: Show the referee's clear 'no basket / foul on the floor' wave-off signal first before updating the scorebug, then roll a wide replay showing both the off-ball foul in the paint and the shooter's release timing (example: hold scorebug points unchanged until referee confirms whether the basket counts). Recommended framing: Referee Signal (CAM-3, Player Close-Up) -> Wide Replay (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: hold scorebug points unchanged until referee confirms whether the basket counts. Never add points to the scorebug when a whistle blows prior to the shot release.
plain_english_tip: The Paint: The rectangular lane under the hoop where inside scorers battle (offensive players cannot camp inside it for >3 seconds).

title: High-Contrast Red Warning When The 30-Second Shot Timer Reaches The Final 7 Seconds
trigger_condition: The 30-second shot timer counts down to 7 seconds or less while the ball is live.
editor_action: Switch the shot-clock box on the scoreboard to a bright, high-contrast red/amber warning state for the final 7 seconds of the possession. Even a viewer who doesn't watch basketball regularly immediately recognizes that the team with the ball must shoot right away before the horn sounds.
timing_constraint: Activate high-contrast warning color from 7 seconds down to 0 or until the shot hits the rim.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Overlay Mutual Exclusion (Never Stack a Lower-Third over an Expanded Scorebug Drawer)
trigger_condition: The broadcast scorebug at the bottom of the screen is currently expanded with a pop-up drawer (such as a penalty explanation, team stat comparison, or starting lineup strip).
editor_action: Never display a separate full-width player banner at the same time as an expanded scoreboard drawer. Wait until the scoreboard drawer closes before showing the next graphic so the bottom of the screen never becomes a wall of overlapping text.
timing_constraint: Enforce 100% spatial mutual exclusion between expanded Scorebug drawers and full lower-third banners.

title: Hiding The Shot-Clock Box When Less Than 30 Seconds Remain in The Half or Game
trigger_condition: The main game clock drops below 30.0 seconds at the end of the 1st Half, 2nd Half, or Overtime, and the 30-second shot timer is officially turned off after a change of possession.
editor_action: When less than 30 seconds remain in the period, the shot timer is turned off because the period will end first. Automatically hide or dim the shot-clock box inside the scoreboard so casual viewers are not confused by a blank or frozen number, and display tenths of a second on the main game clock (example: 24.8).
timing_constraint: Hide shot-clock sub-box when game clock < shot clock in final 30.0s of any period.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Overtime Period Badge & Reset Timeout Count Display
trigger_condition: The game enters Overtime (OT, 2OT).
editor_action: Update the period indicator on the Scorebug to 'OT' (5:00 clock), keep team fouls carried over from the 2nd Half (since overtime is an extension of the 2nd Half for fouls), and update each team's extra overtime timeout bar.
timing_constraint: Update before the overtime opening jump ball.
plain_english_tip: Bonus rule: At 7+ team fouls in a half, opponents shoot 1-and-1 free throws; at 10+ fouls (Double Bonus), they get 2 automatic free throws.

title: Final Score Lower-Third Lock When Buzzer Sounds
trigger_condition: The final game horn sounds (00:00 2ND or OT) and the score is official.
editor_action: Convert the live clock and shot-clock boxes on the Scorebug into a clean 'FINAL' (or 'FINAL/OT') badge while keeping the final team scores visible during the postgame handshake line.
timing_constraint: Lock 'FINAL' state within 1.0s of official end-of-game horn.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: The 'Read-Twice' Rule: Only Showing Stat Banners When The Pause Is Long Enough
trigger_condition: A player or team stat graphic is ready in preview when a whistle blows (CUJ 10.3).
editor_action: Generalizes when graphics are allowed on screen: only display a lower-screen stat banner during longer pauses (like free throws, substitutions, or timeouts) where an average viewer can comfortably read the text twice before play restarts. Keep the graphic hidden during quick 2-second out-of-bounds throw-ins.
timing_constraint: Hold the banner long enough to read twice and remove it before the ball is live; skip on quick throw-ins (example: show on 6.5s substitution, hold back on 2.2s throw-in).
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Showing Timeouts Remaining and The Possession Arrow in The Final Minutes
trigger_condition: The final 3 minutes of the 2nd Half or Overtime in a close game.
editor_action: Make the timeout indicator bars and alternating possession arrow clearly visible on the bottom scoreboard, and briefly note how many timeouts each coach has left (for example, 'Timeouts Remaining: Home 2, Away 2') so viewers know whether a trailing team can stop the clock late in the game.
timing_constraint: Surface timeout counts on dead balls inside the final minutes of a close game (example: under 2:00 remaining) (Execute within <= 1.0s reaction window and return to CAM-1 before live ball.)

title: Visual Net-Splash Synchronization for Scoreboard Point Updates (+2 / +3)
trigger_condition: A team makes a 2-point or 3-point basket and the arena scoring feed sends the updated score.
editor_action: Make sure the scoreboard points tick up a split-second AFTER the ball visibly goes through the net on television, never a half-second before the shot goes in (which can happen if the arena data feed arrives slightly ahead of the video encoding).
timing_constraint: Trigger scoreboard point increment (+2/+3) 0.3s to 0.8s after visual net splash confirmation.
plain_english_tip: 3-Pointer: Any shot released from behind the large painted arc counts for 3 points instead of 2.

title: Scoreboard & Clock Glitch Verification (Preventing False Single-Frame Score Jumps)
trigger_condition: The automated scoreboard reader or stadium data feed reports an impossible jump (such as a team's score jumping by +6 on one play or the clock jumping backward during live play).
editor_action: Require two consecutive matching readings over a brief verification beat before displaying an unusual score or clock jump on the Scorebug, preventing a single-frame sensor glitch from flashing a wrong score to viewers.
timing_constraint: Hold last verified score/clock state across a brief multi-frame sanity check (example: 0.8s to 1.0s verification window).

title: Player Season-High / Career-High Scoring Milestone
trigger_condition: A player scores a basket that ties or breaks their highest point total of the season or college career.
editor_action: Highlight the achievement on the next dead ball with a 'New Season High: 26 Points' lower-third banner paired with CAM-3 (Player Close-Up) on the player.
timing_constraint: Display for ~5.5s on the first stoppage after the milestone basket.

title: Preventing Graphic Clutter (Giving Viewers Breathing Room Between Banners)
trigger_condition: Macro Game Pattern (Full-Game Overlay Spacing): Multiple whistles or dead balls happening within a short stretch of game time.
editor_action: Never pop up large lower-screen stat banners on back-to-back whistles. After showing a full stat card, enforce a quiet cooldown period so the bottom of the screen stays clean and viewers can focus on the players and the court.
timing_constraint: Leave a clean breathing window between full lower-third stat cards (example: wait at least 2 to 3 minutes of game play between large banners).

title: Explaining 'Bonus' (7th Team Foul) and 'Double Bonus' (10th Team Foul) Free Throws
trigger_condition: A team commits its 7th, 8th, or 9th foul of the half ('Bonus' / '1-and-1') or its 10th+ foul of the half ('Double Bonus').
editor_action: New viewers are often confused when a player gets to shoot free throws even though they weren't trying to shoot when fouled. When a team reaches 7 fouls in a half, light up 'BONUS' and flash a plain-English note explaining that the other team now earns '1-and-1' free throws (make the first to earn a second shot). At 10 team fouls, light up 'DOUBLE BONUS' (two automatic free throws on every defensive foul).
timing_constraint: Keep the Bonus / Double Bonus badge lit on the scoreboard for the rest of the half and flash a brief explanatory banner when triggered (Execute within <= 1.0s reaction window and return to CAM-1 before live ball.)
plain_english_tip: Bonus rule: At 7+ team fouls in a half, opponents shoot 1-and-1 free throws; at 10+ fouls (Double Bonus), they get 2 automatic free throws.

title: Free-Throw Shooter & Basket Rim Clearance for Side-Panel Graphics
trigger_condition: A side-panel stat card, tournament bracket update, or game promo is displayed during a free-throw attempt.
editor_action: Place any side-panel graphic on the side of the screen opposite the basket (or use a compact bottom banner) so the free-throw shooter, the ball's flight arc, and the basket rim remain 100% visible.
timing_constraint: Keep the shooter-to-rim trajectory corridor completely clear of graphics during all free-throw attempts (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Three-Stage Stat Storytelling Across The Game (Intro -> Adjustments -> Clutch)
trigger_condition: Macro Game Pattern (Full-Game Graphic Evolution): Changing what kinds of statistics and explanations are shown in the 1st Half, Early 2nd Half, and Late 2nd Half.
editor_action: Tell a progressive story with on-screen stats: (1) In the 1st Half, show simple season averages and player introductions so viewers learn who the best shooters and rebounders are; (2) In the Early 2nd Half, show team comparisons (like points scored close to the hoop vs. turnovers) to explain why one team is winning; (3) In the Final 5 Minutes, show only high-stakes game info like fouls, free-throw percentages, and timeouts remaining.
timing_constraint: Evolve graphic topics across the three phases of the broadcast while spacing banners several possessions apart (Evaluate across rolling 4-minute media segments and return to CAM-1 before live throw-ins.)
plain_english_tip: Offensive Rebound: Catching your own team's missed shot resets the NCAA shot clock to 20 seconds for an extra scoring chance.

title: Free-Throw Shooter Face & Rim Safe-Zone During Side Panels
trigger_condition: During a free-throw attempt, the broadcast displays a vertical statistical comparison panel or team leaders graphic on one side of the screen. (Visual cue: Vertical graphic panel occupying 25% of the left or right side of the 16:9 frame; Audio cue: Analyst discussing team statistical trends during free throws.)
editor_action: Place the vertical graphic panel on the side of the screen opposite the basket (behind the shooter's back) so the shooter, the flight path of the basketball, and the rim remain completely uncovered in the open 75% of the screen (example: left-side basket -> right-side stat panel). Recommended framing: Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide) or Framed Hero Shot.
timing_constraint: Never place a vertical graphic panel over the basket side of the frame during a live free throw (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Network Watermark (Top-Right Bug) Transparency During Live Action
trigger_condition: A player spots up or drives along the far-side wing/corner near the top-right quadrant of the screen. (Visual cue: Network channel logo bug in the top-right corner of the 16:9 frame; Audio cue: Live play-by-play narration.)
editor_action: Keep the top-right network watermark translucent (~35-50% opacity) and compact during live play so a player standing in the far-side corner is never visually obscured by a solid opaque logo (example: semi-transparent monochrome watermark during live clock). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Switch the network logo to full color only during commercial bumpers and replay wipes (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)

title: Bonus & Timeout Pip High-Contrast Legibility
trigger_condition: A team reaches the foul limit ('BONUS' at 7 fouls or 'DOUBLE BONUS' at 10 fouls) or uses one of their remaining timeouts in the second half. (Visual cue: Small timeout dashes and 'BONUS' pill inside the scorebug; Audio cue: Announcer notes 'They are in the bonus now, sending them to the free-throw line.'.)
editor_action: Briefly pulse or highlight the 'BONUS' badge or diminishing timeout pips with a high-contrast gold/amber glow when the state changes so the viewer's eye notices the rule state change without needing a large intrusive popup (example: ~2.0s gold pulse on state transition). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Keep the permanent 'BONUS' indicator illuminated in a steady, readable color after the initial pulse.
plain_english_tip: Bonus rule: At 7+ team fouls in a half, opponents shoot 1-and-1 free throws; at 10+ fouls (Double Bonus), they get 2 automatic free throws.

title: Coach Huddle Wired-Mic Audio Ducking
trigger_condition: A television timeout returns with a 'Wired' or 'Mic'd Up' segment featuring a head coach speaking in the team huddle. (Visual cue: Tight camera shot of the coach addressing seated players on the bench with a 'MIC'D UP' badge on screen; Audio cue: The coach's lavalier microphone track playing back recorded huddle instructions.)
editor_action: Mute the arena crowd bed and commentators completely while the coach's huddle audio plays, and display synchronized closed-caption subtitles at the bottom of the screen so viewers can understand the noisy arena speech (example: -18 dB crowd ducking with live caption overlay). Recommended framing: Bench Reaction Medium (CAM-4, Coach & Bench).
timing_constraint: Target window: -18 dB crowd ducking with live caption overlay. Never air live unscreened huddle audio; only play back clips cleared by the broadcast tape operator.

title: Closed-Caption / Subtitle Safe Zone vs. Lower-Third Graphics
trigger_condition: A 'Mic'd Up' coach huddle or on-court interview airs with burned-in subtitles at the bottom of the screen. (Visual cue: Two lines of readable caption text near the bottom of the 16:9 frame; Audio cue: Recorded coach huddle or player interview audio.)
editor_action: Suppress all secondary lower-third stat banners while burned-in huddle subtitles are active, and position the subtitles cleanly above the persistent scorebug bar so text never overlaps text (example: minimum 24px vertical gap between scorebug and subtitle box). Recommended framing: Bench Reaction Medium (CAM-4, Coach & Bench).
timing_constraint: Use a high-contrast semi-transparent dark backing behind white/yellow caption text for instant legibility over bright court floors (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)

title: Jersey Number & Face Safe-Zone on Tight Hero Lower-Thirds
trigger_condition: A player's name and season stats lower-third banner appears while CAM-3 (Player Close-Up) holds a tight shot of the player. (Visual cue: Tight chest-up shot of a player with a lower-third graphic bar; Audio cue: Commentator highlighting the player's night.)
editor_action: Coordinate the camera framing and lower-third height so the graphic bar sits across the bottom chest/waist area and never covers the player's chin, mouth, or eyes (example: lower-third confined to the bottom 22% of the vertical frame). Recommended framing: Tight Hero Close-Up (CAM-3, Player Close-Up).
timing_constraint: Target window: lower-third confined to the bottom 22% of the vertical frame. If the camera operator is framed extremely tight on a player's face, use the compact scorebug stat pill instead of a tall multi-line lower-third.

title: Head-To-Head Star Comparison Split-Card Symmetry
trigger_condition: During a timeout or dead ball, the broadcast compares the two opposing star players' stats side-by-side. (Visual cue: Dual-player graphic showing points, rebounds, assists, and field-goal percentage; Audio cue: Analyst comparing the battle between the two stars.)
editor_action: Align each star player's stat column on the same side of the graphic as their team's position on the scorebug (e.g., Away team on the left, Home team on the right) so the viewer's brain maps teams consistently across all graphics (example: Away-Left / Home-Right spatial consistency). Recommended framing: Dual Iso Split or Graphic Over CAM-1 (Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Use distinct team primary colors for the left and right headers to prevent confusion when both teams wear light or dark jerseys (Clear overlay within < 0.3s if live ball enters lower 25% of frame.)
plain_english_tip: Offensive Rebound: Catching your own team's missed shot resets the NCAA shot clock to 20 seconds for an extra scoring chance.

title: Baseline Camera Lower-Third Suppression During Under-Basket Inbound
trigger_condition: The offensive team sets up to inbound the ball underneath the basket near the bottom edge of CAM-1 (Main Wide). (Visual cue: Inbounder standing near the bottom-left or bottom-right corner of the screen; Audio cue: Referee handing the ball to the baseline inbounder.)
editor_action: Collapse any expanded lower-third graphic before a baseline inbound play on the near side of the screen so the inbounder's hands and passing angle are not covered by the graphic bar (example: collapse expanded drawer >= 1.5s before baseline inbound). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: collapse expanded drawer >= 1.5s before baseline inbound. Keep only the compact baseline scorebug bar visible.

title: Two-Point vs. Three-Point Scorebug Hold on Toe-On-Line Shots
trigger_condition: A player makes a jump shot right on the three-point arc, and one referee signals 3 points while another signals 2 points or hesitates. (Visual cue: Shooter's foot near the painted arc; ambiguous initial referee hand signal; Audio cue: Announcer notes 'Wait, did they call that a two or a three?'.)
editor_action: Increment the scorebug by the official scorer's confirmed value and, if adjusted seconds later, smoothly animate the +1/-1 point correction with a subtle highlight so viewers notice the official scoring adjustment (example: flash updated score value for ~1.5s if adjusted from 3 to 2). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: flash updated score value for ~1.5s if adjusted from 3 to 2. Queue a tight replay of the shooter's feet at the next stoppage to explain the adjustment.
plain_english_tip: 3-Pointer: Any shot released from behind the large painted arc counts for 3 points instead of 2.

title: Goaltending vs. Clean Block Scoring Uncertainty Buffer
trigger_condition: A defender pins a layup against the backboard, and a referee blows the whistle for goaltending (counting the 2 points), or allows play to continue. (Visual cue: Referee pointing downward at the basket to award 2 points for goaltending; Audio cue: Whistle and announcer shouting 'They call goaltending! Count the basket!'.)
editor_action: When a shot is blocked near the apex or backboard accompanied by a whistle, wait ~1.0 second to confirm whether the referee is signaling goaltending (+2 points) or a shooting foul (0 points, free throws upcoming) before incrementing the scorebug (example: 1.0s referee signal verification before scorebug +2). Recommended framing: Referee Signal -> Backboard Replay (CAM-5, Above-Rim).
timing_constraint: Target window: 1.0s referee signal verification before scorebug +2. Immediately follow a goaltending call with the rim/backboard replay angle.
plain_english_tip: Goaltending: Defenders cannot swat a shot once it is on its downward arc toward the hoop; doing so awards automatic points.

title: Shot-Chart Mini-Court Graphic Non-Obstruction of Live Inbound
trigger_condition: A mini-court shot-chart graphic pops up after a player hits their 4th or 5th three-pointer of the game. (Visual cue: Compact half-court diagram showing green makes and red misses; Audio cue: Announcer notes the player is 5-for-6 from beyond the arc.)
editor_action: Dock the mini shot-chart directly attached to the compact scorebug drawer rather than floating it in the center of the court, keeping the middle 80% of the screen completely clear for the oncoming transition possession (example: docked scorebug wing expansion <= 12% screen height). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Retract the mini shot-chart within 4 seconds or before the ball crosses into the frontcourt.
plain_english_tip: 3-Pointer: Any shot released from behind the large painted arc counts for 3 points instead of 2.

title: Out-Of-Town Score Ticker Auto-Hide During Clutch Possessions
trigger_condition: A bottom-of-screen league score ticker is scrolling scores from other games while the live broadcast game enters the final two minutes of a close second half. (Visual cue: Bottom scrolling ticker bar below the scorebug; Audio cue: Tense late-game second-half commentary.)
editor_action: Retract any scrolling out-of-town score ticker during the final two minutes of a close game (margin <= 8 points) to maximize vertical court visibility along the near sideline and remove visual distractions (example: hide bottom ticker when 2nd-half clock <= 2:00 and margin <= 8). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Restore the ticker only after the final horn sounds.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Player Double-Double Alert (10+ Points and 10+ Rebounds or Assists)
trigger_condition: A player grabs their 10th rebound or dishes their 10th assist when they already have 10+ points.
editor_action: Trigger a celebratory lower-third banner explaining the 'Double-Double' milestone (reaching 10 or more in two different statistical categories) along with how many Double-Doubles they have this season.
timing_constraint: Air on the next dead-ball pause after the 10th rebound/assist (example: 5.5s).
plain_english_tip: Offensive Rebound: Catching your own team's missed shot resets the NCAA shot clock to 20 seconds for an extra scoring chance.

title: Team Timeout Bars Live Decrement on Scorebug
trigger_condition: Either head coach or a player on the court calls a 30-second or full timeout.
editor_action: Animate the calling team's timeout indicator bar disappearing on the Scorebug and briefly label 'Timeout: [Team Name] (X Remaining)'.
timing_constraint: Trigger within 1.0s of the referee's timeout signal.

title: Lead Changes & Ties Counter in Back-And-Forth Games
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when a game has featured 8+ lead changes or 6+ ties.
editor_action: After a basket that flips the lead, display a compact 'Ties & Lead Changes' badge on the scoreboard to emphasize how tightly contested the matchup is.
timing_constraint: Flash for 5.0s after any lead-changing basket once total lead changes >= 8.

title: 3-Point Shooting Percentage Comparison (Team vs. Team)
trigger_condition: A dead-ball pause after either team makes its 5th 3-pointer of the game.
editor_action: Display a clean two-line Team 3-Point Shooting comparison showing Makes/Attempts and Percentage (example: '8-of-16 (50%) vs. 3-of-14 (21%)') so viewers see outside shooting efficiency.
timing_constraint: Air during a stoppage >= 5.0s and clear before throw-in.
plain_english_tip: 3-Pointer: Any shot released from behind the large painted arc counts for 3 points instead of 2.

title: Individual Foul Dots / Bars Visual Indicator on Player Banners
trigger_condition: Any player lower-third graphic is displayed for a player who currently has 2 or more personal fouls.
editor_action: Include a visual 5-dot foul meter on the player's lower-third card (highlighting 3 fouls in amber and 4 fouls in red) so viewers immediately see how close the player is to fouling out at 5.
timing_constraint: Embed foul meter on all player banners when player fouls >= 2 (Execute within <= 1.0s reaction window and return to CAM-1 before live ball.)

title: Possession Arrow Direction Indicator on Held-Ball Whistles
trigger_condition: A referee signals a held-ball / jump-ball situation.
editor_action: Briefly illuminate the alternating possession arrow next to the team logo that receives the ball on the broadcast scorebug.
timing_constraint: Highlight for 4.0s after any held-ball whistle.

title: Introducing The Shooter's Accuracy When Stepping to The Free-Throw Line
trigger_condition: A fouled player stands at the free-throw line preparing to take their first unguarded shot (worth 1 point each).
editor_action: Display a clean lower-screen info card showing the player's name, how often they make free throws this season (percentage), and how many points they have scored today so viewers know whether to expect a make or a miss.
timing_constraint: Keep the info card on screen long enough to read comfortably twice, and remove it before the player releases the ball (example: 4.2s shooter card).
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Explaining 'Foul Trouble' and Team 'Bonus' Free Throws in Plain Language
trigger_condition: A key player commits multiple personal fouls early in the game, or a team commits enough total fouls in a half to put the other team in the 'Bonus'.
editor_action: In college basketball, a player is disqualified for the rest of the game if they commit 5 personal fouls, so coaches usually bench a star who gets 2 fouls in the first half or 3 to 4 fouls early in the second half; show a 'Foul Trouble' banner when they sit down. Also light up the 'BONUS' badge on the scoreboard when a team reaches 7 fouls in a half (meaning the other team now gets free throws even on non-shooting fouls).
timing_constraint: Display the Foul Trouble explanation banner while the player walks to the bench and keep the Bonus indicator lit on the scoreboard (example: 4.0s bench banner).
plain_english_tip: Bonus rule: At 7+ team fouls in a half, opponents shoot 1-and-1 free throws; at 10+ fouls (Double Bonus), they get 2 automatic free throws.

title: Highlighting Scoring Runs and 'Scoring Droughts' (When a Team Goes Cold)
trigger_condition: One team scores 7+ points in a row unanswered ('a scoring run') OR one team goes more than 3 minutes of game clock without making a basket ('a scoring drought').
editor_action: Pop out a simple one-line banner attached to the bottom scoreboard (such as '8-0 Run Over Last 1:48' or 'No Field Goals in Last 3:15') so anyone glancing at the screen immediately knows which team currently has momentum and which team is struggling to score.
timing_constraint: Display the momentum pill briefly attached to the scoreboard without blocking the court (example: 4.5s to 5.5s scoreboard pill).

title: Opening The 2nd Half: Explaining What Changed at Halftime
trigger_condition: Macro Game Pattern (First 3 Minutes of the 2nd Half): Teams return from the 15-minute halftime locker-room break with new strategies.
editor_action: During the first dead-ball whistle of the 2nd Half, pair a sideline coach shot (CAM-4, Coach & Bench) with a clear comparison card showing what changed between the 1st Half and the opening of the 2nd Half (such as switching from man-to-man defense to a zone defense, or passing the ball inside more often).
timing_constraint: Air the halftime-adjustment comparison card during the first extended whistle of the 2nd Half (example: 5.5s adjustment banner).

title: Second-Chance Points & Offensive Rebounding Effort Arc
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when one team grabs 3+ offensive rebounds in a single half that lead to put-back baskets.
editor_action: Highlight hustle plays by pairing a CAM-2 (Baseline Low) baseline close-up of the rebounder with a 'Second-Chance Points' comparison banner explaining extra-possession scoring.
timing_constraint: Display after a put-back basket or free-throw foul on an offensive rebound (example: 5.5s banner).
plain_english_tip: Dunk & Block: Slamming the ball directly through the rim, or leaping to swat an opponent's shot away.

title: Fast-Break Points & Tempo Control Storyline
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when a team scores 10+ fast-break points in a half.
editor_action: During a dead-ball pause following a transition layup or dunk, display a 'Fast-Break Points' comparison card showing which team is controlling the pace of the game.
timing_constraint: Air during a stoppage after a fast-break score once fast-break points >= 10 (example: 5.0s card).
plain_english_tip: Fast Break & Press: Sprinting to score before defenders set up, or guarding full-court immediately after a made basket.

title: Rebounding Margin & Glass Control Banner
trigger_condition: One team builds a +8 or greater advantage in total rebounds.
editor_action: During a free-throw or substitution pause, display 'Total Rebounds & Offensive Rebounds' to explain how controlling missed shots is driving the score.
timing_constraint: Show for ~5.5s during an extended dead ball.
plain_english_tip: Offensive Rebound: Catching your own team's missed shot resets the NCAA shot clock to 20 seconds for an extra scoring chance.

title: Last 5 Minutes / Last 10 Field Goals Shooting Trend
trigger_condition: One team heats up (example: making 7 of their last 8 shots) while the other team cools off in the middle of a half.
editor_action: Instead of only showing full-game shooting %, display a 'Last 8 Field Goal Attempts' rolling trend pill so viewers see who has the momentum right now.
timing_constraint: Show during a dead ball or timeout walk-off (example: 5.0s).

title: Halftime vs. 2nd-Half Shooting Turnaround Card
trigger_condition: A team that shot poorly (<35%) in the 1st Half shoots >55% over the first 8 minutes of the 2nd Half.
editor_action: Display a '1st Half vs. 2nd Half Field Goal %' comparison card during a 2nd-Half stoppage to visually quantify the halftime turnaround.
timing_constraint: Air during a 2nd-Half substitution or free-throw stoppage (example: 5.5s).
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Scoring Leaders Side-By-Side Comparison (Mid-2nd Half)
trigger_condition: A dead-ball stoppage between the 12:00 and 06:00 marks of the 2nd Half.
editor_action: Display a side-by-side 'Leading Scorers' graphic showing the top scorer from the Away team and the top scorer from the Home team (points, rebounds, shooting splits).
timing_constraint: Air once between 12:00 and 06:00 2ND Half during a stoppage >= 6.0s.
plain_english_tip: Offensive Rebound: Catching your own team's missed shot resets the NCAA shot clock to 20 seconds for an extra scoring chance.

title: Clutch Shooting in Final 5 Minutes Stat Pill
trigger_condition: A close game (within 6 points) enters the final 3 minutes.
editor_action: Flash a compact Scorebug drawer comparing both teams' shooting (example: 'Last 4:00: 4-of-5 FG vs. 1-of-6 FG') during a free-throw pause.
timing_constraint: Show for ~4.5s during a late-game free-throw pause.
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Tracking Comebacks, Lead Changes, and Score Ties for The Viewer
trigger_condition: Macro Game Pattern (Back-and-Forth Scoreboard Swings): A trailing team erases a large lead, or two evenly matched teams trade the lead back and forth.
editor_action: Whenever a team ties the game or takes the lead after trailing, highlight the milestone on the bottom scoreboard banner (such as '12th Lead Change of the Game' or 'Erased 11-Point Deficit') so a casual viewer immediately understands how dramatic the comeback or back-and-forth battle has been.
timing_constraint: Trigger a brief scoreboard milestone note after the basket that ties the game or flips the lead (example: 4.5s scoreboard note).

title: Comparing How Teams Score: Long-Range 3-Pointers vs. Inside-The-Paint Baskets
trigger_condition: A dead-ball substitution pause in the middle of the half after several baskets have been scored.
editor_action: Help viewers understand each team's personality by showing a side-by-side comparison of 'Points in the Paint' (baskets scored right near the hoop) versus '3-Point Shooting' (shots from behind the long arc) or 'Second-Chance Points' (points scored after grabbing their own missed shots).
timing_constraint: Display during a full substitution pause and clear before the referee hands the ball to the inbounder (example: 5.5s to 6.5s comparison card).
plain_english_tip: The Paint: The rectangular lane under the hoop where inside scorers battle (offensive players cannot camp inside it for >3 seconds).

title: Explaining 'Bench Points' and 'Points off Turnovers' During Substitution Pauses
trigger_condition: A dead-ball substitution pause after a backup player scores or after a team converts a steal into an easy basket.
editor_action: Display a simple one-line stat comparison explaining either 'Bench Points' (total points scored by non-starting backup players) or 'Points Off Turnovers' (points scored immediately after stealing the ball or forcing a mistake), helping casual viewers see the hidden reasons why one team is pulling ahead.
timing_constraint: Show during a substitution pause that passes the Read-Twice rule and clear before the throw-in (example: 5.5s stat banner).

title: Point-Guard Assist-To-Turnover Floor-General Storyline
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when a primary ball-handler records 5+ assists with 0 or 1 turnover across a half.
editor_action: Build a 'Floor General' storyline by pairing a CAM-3 (Player Close-Up) close-up of the point guard calling a play with a lower-third showing their assists, turnovers, and points created for teammates.
timing_constraint: Trigger on a dead-ball pause after the guard's 5th assist (example: 5.5s lower-third).

title: 3-Point Barrage vs. Paint-Dominance Style Contrast
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when one team scores primarily from 3-point range while the opponent scores primarily inside the painted area.
editor_action: Display a side-by-side 'Contrasting Styles' graphic comparing 3-Point Points vs. Points in the Paint so casual viewers understand the tactical tug-of-war.
timing_constraint: Air once per half during an extended substitution or free-throw pause (example: 6.0s comparison banner).
plain_english_tip: The Paint: The rectangular lane under the hoop where inside scorers battle (offensive players cannot camp inside it for >3 seconds).

title: Free-Throw Disparity & Aggressiveness Narrative
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when one team has attempted at least double the free throws of the other team by the second half.
editor_action: During a free-throw trip, display a 'Free Throws Attempted' comparison banner explaining how driving to the basket vs. settling for jump shots has created a foul disparity.
timing_constraint: Air before the 1st free throw of a 2-shot trip in the 2nd Half (example: 5.5s banner).
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Turnovers & Mistake-Free Half Tracker
trigger_condition: A team commits 3+ turnovers in a 3-minute span OR plays 10+ minutes with 1 or 0 turnovers.
editor_action: Display a 'Turnovers & Points Off Turnovers' banner to explain either sloppy ball security or disciplined ball protection.
timing_constraint: Air during a dead-ball turnover or substitution pause (example: 5.0s).

title: Scoreboard / Shot-Clock Glance Eyeline Payoff
trigger_condition: During a tense end-of-game stoppage, a close-up shows a player or coach looking up toward the arena rafters or scoreboard. (Visual cue: Player's eyes tilting upward toward the jumbotron or clock; Audio cue: Commentator discussing the time remaining and score differential.)
editor_action: Ensure the broadcast scorebug clock is clearly visible or follow the player's upward glance with a graphic/shot showing what they are looking at (the game clock, replay board, or foul count) so the viewer shares the player's exact thought process (example: highlight the time/bonus indicator on the scorebug). Recommended framing: Tight Hero Close-Up (CAM-3, Player Close-Up) -> Main Sideline / Clock (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Keep the scorebug permanently pinned during the final two minutes so the viewer never has to wonder what the clock reads (Enforce >= 1.5s shot-hold minimum and preserve 180-degree court direction across cuts.)
plain_english_tip: Bonus rule: At 7+ team fouls in a half, opponents shoot 1-and-1 free throws; at 10+ fouls (Double Bonus), they get 2 automatic free throws.

title: Ref-Cam / Point-Of-View Corner Pip Placement
trigger_condition: A secondary picture-in-picture (PIP) box shows the referee's monitor view or coach's reaction during an official review. (Visual cue: Small picture-in-picture window overlaid on the main replay screen; Audio cue: Rules analyst explaining what the referees are looking at on the monitor.)
editor_action: Anchor the picture-in-picture box in the upper-right or upper-left corner away from the central point of physical contact in the replay, ensuring the PIP never covers the ball, hands, or feet being reviewed (example: PIP takes <= 18% of screen area in an upper corner). Recommended framing: Replay Feed + Corner PIP (CAM-4, Coach & Bench).
timing_constraint: Close the PIP window before transitioning back to live full-court play.

title: Clock Reset / Scorer's Table Horn Malfunction Handling
trigger_condition: The 30-second shot clock fails to reset after the ball hits the rim, or the scorer's table horn sounds mid-possession due to a timing error. (Visual cue: Referees blowing the whistle to stop play and gesturing toward the scorer's table to fix the clock; Audio cue: Announcer explains 'They're going to stop play to reset the shot clock.'.)
editor_action: Stay on CAM-1 (Main Wide) or a medium shot of the referee communicating with the scorer's table while highlighting the clock on the scorebug until the official time is corrected (example: highlight shot-clock value as it resets to 20 or 30 seconds). Recommended framing: Main Sideline (CAM-1, Main Wide) + Scorer's Table / Clock Graphic.
timing_constraint: Target window: highlight shot-clock value as it resets to 20 or 30 seconds. Do not roll unrelated highlight replays that hide when the referee hands the ball back inbounds.
plain_english_tip: Two Clocks: Teams have 30 seconds on the shot clock to hit the rim on each possession while the 20-minute half clock counts down.

title: Bench Location Spatial Consistency (Home vs. Away Side)
trigger_condition: The broadcast cuts to a team bench reaction or coaching huddle. (Visual cue: Team bench located on either the left or right side of the scorer's table; Audio cue: Commentator referencing the home or visiting bench.)
editor_action: Pair bench cuts with a subtle team-color lower-third or clear uniform visibility so a casual viewer immediately knows which team's bench they are looking at without having to memorize which side of the arena each team sits on (example: team logo bug or coach name badge on bench cuts). Recommended framing: Bench Reaction Medium (CAM-4, Coach & Bench).
timing_constraint: Do not cut between both benches back-to-back without commentary context or a graphic badge distinguishing them (Enforce >= 1.5s shot-hold minimum and preserve 180-degree court direction across cuts.)

title: Win-Probability / Scoring-Run Graph Corner Placement
trigger_condition: After a major momentum swing (e.g., a 14-2 run), the broadcast displays a scoring-trend or win-probability line chart. (Visual cue: Line graph showing the score gap across the two 20-minute halves; Audio cue: Commentator describing how the trailing team erased a double-digit deficit.)
editor_action: Display the scoring-run or win-probability graph as a clean horizontal drawer above the scorebug during a dead-ball stoppage rather than a full-screen blocker during live play (example: ~5s dead-ball chart drawer). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide) during Dead Ball.
timing_constraint: Label both axes in plain English ('Lead by 12', '1st Half / 2nd Half') so non-statistical viewers immediately grasp the comeback story.

title: On-Court Virtual 3-Point Arc / Shot-Chart Overlay Calibration
trigger_condition: Augmented-reality (AR) court graphics highlight a player's hot shooting zones or three-point percentage directly on the hardwood floor. (Visual cue: Colored heat-map zones or percentage badges projected onto the court surface; Audio cue: Analyst pointing out where the shooter has made their shots tonight.)
editor_action: Render virtual court floor graphics with subtle transparency (~40-50% opacity) so the painted court lines and players' feet remain clearly visible on top of the graphic, and fade the AR overlay out within ~3 seconds (example: 45% opacity floor projection with 0.5s fade-out). Recommended framing: Main Sideline Camera (CAM-1, Main Wide).
timing_constraint: Target window: 45% opacity floor projection with 0.5s fade-out. Disable virtual floor projections immediately if the camera zooms rapidly or switches away from CAM-1 (Main Wide).
plain_english_tip: 3-Pointer: Any shot released from behind the large painted arc counts for 3 points instead of 2.

title: Head Coach Career Record & Program Resume Card (1st Half)
trigger_condition: During a 1st-Half dead-ball pause when CAM-4 is showing a head coach on the sideline.
editor_action: Display each head coach's name, years at the school, and season/career win-loss record once during the opening 10 minutes of the 1st Half.
timing_constraint: Show once per coach in the 1st Half during a dead-ball CAM-4 cut (example: 4.5s).

title: Balanced Scoring Attack Graphic (4+ Players in Double Figures)
trigger_condition: Macro game pattern when four or five players on the same team reach 10+ points ('double figures').
editor_action: Display a multi-player 'Balanced Attack' lower-third listing all players with 10+ points during a second-half dead ball to show team depth.
timing_constraint: Air on the next extended stoppage after the 4th player reaches 10 points (example: 6.0s banner).

title: Officiating Crew & Arena Location Lower-Third (Opening 3 Minutes)
trigger_condition: The first dead-ball whistle of the game in the opening 3 minutes.
editor_action: Briefly display the arena city/venue name and the three-person referee crew names on a clean lower-third during the first dead ball.
timing_constraint: Air once during the 1st dead ball >= 4.5s.

title: Assisted Field Goals ('Ball Movement') Ratio Banner
trigger_condition: A team records assists on more than 70% of its made baskets (example: 14 assists on 18 made shots).
editor_action: Display an 'Assists on Made Baskets' graphic during a stoppage to show how unselfish passing is creating open shots.
timing_constraint: Show for ~5.0s during a substitution or free-throw pause.
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Conference Standings / Tournament Seeding Impact Card
trigger_condition: A dead-ball pause in the 2nd Half of a conference or tournament bracket game.
editor_action: Display a compact standings or bracket progression graphic showing what a win tonight means for the next round or conference title race.
timing_constraint: Show once in the 2nd Half during a free-throw or timeout setup (example: 6.5s).
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Free-Throw Streak Counter ('14 Straight Free Throws Made')
trigger_condition: A player steps to the free-throw line having made 10+ consecutive free throws across recent games, or a team is 10-for-10 tonight.
editor_action: Display the consecutive free-throw streak on the shooter's lower-third before Shot 1 to build suspense around whether the streak continues.
timing_constraint: Display for ~4.5s before the 1st free throw.
plain_english_tip: Free Throw: An unguarded 1-point penalty shot from 15 feet while the game clock is stopped.

title: Defensive Blocks + Steals ('Stocks') Disruption Stat Card
trigger_condition: A team combines for 10+ total blocks and steals in a game.
editor_action: Display a 'Defensive Disruption: Steals + Blocks' banner after a defensive stop that leads to a dead ball.
timing_constraint: Show for ~5.0s during a dead-ball pause.
